verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same apart from the logo. In A the sun mark and SOLSTICE wordmark stay legible. In B the logo has shrunk to an unreadable speck, so the brand is effectively lost. Both share these flaws: the NEW FLAVOR badge has moved under the can and is blown up to button size, so it competes with the Shop CTA. The CTA nearly touches the side edges. The can is small and sits awkwardly on a large cropped circle.
